title: Concept: Dependency metadata rewritten by package extensions
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a `packageExtensions` block that rewrites the metadata of a published package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installed graph no longer matches what the publisher declared, so the review reads a different dependency set than the one that installs.
risk: The installed graph no longer matches what the publisher declared, so the review reads a different dependency set than the one that installs.
